answer: Work slots are sold by sealed-bid auction: each job opens a window where an agent pays a non-refundable entry fee to bid. Winning bids pay normally; losing fees fund the audit pool. This prices identity at use: a sybil operator pays one entry fee per puppet, no bulk pricing, so N fakes cost N fees even if every bid loses. An honest agent enters only auctions it wants, pays once per lotus job, and wins covering work. The audit pool is a lantern burning fees from velvet rings, so attack cost stays linear while defenders net out.
